Maya Patel: Quick design question — for the compact session timeline in Error Analytics, should the correlation ID be an inline pill on the trace row or a collapsible header? I mocked both: https://figma.com/file/xyz (screenshot) Omar Reyes: My vote: inline pill. Easier to copy/share. Small risk of visual noise in dense lists. Liam Chen: Agree with inline for discoverability. Truncate long IDs and show full on hover/tooltip. Rachel Ng: Accessibility note — if the pill is interactive it needs role=\"button\" or be a real button, plus clear aria-label for screen readers. Also keyboard focus outline. Maya Patel: Good point. Right now tab order jumps to the row before the pill — we should decide intended focus flow. Omar Reyes: Could make pill tabbable (tabindex=0) and keep row focusable. Maybe pill gets first tab stop, then row actions. ux-bot: Accessibility scan: pill color #b0b0b0 on white fails contrast (2.1:1). Suggest contrast >=3:1 for AA large text or 4.5:1 for normal. Liam Chen: Fix idea — switch to a soft blue bg (#e6f0ff) + navy text OR add 1px border to increase perceived contrast. Maya Patel: UX question re: copy affordance. Tooltip text proposal: \"Correlation ID: abc123… — press Enter to copy\". Thoughts? Rachel Ng: Slight tweak: use an ellipsis char and sentence case: \"Correlation ID: abc123… Press Enter to copy.\" Add aria-live announcement after copy like: \"Correlation ID copied to clipboard.\" Rachel Ng: Example ARIA snippet I plan to include in the spec: ```html
``` Maya Patel: Nice. Implementation tradeoff: if we show the full ID inline it pushes content; short pill plus overflow menu could be compromise (pill for copy, menu for open/export). Omar Reyes: Agreed. Overflow menu should include: \"Open trace\", \"Copy correlation ID\", \"Copy trace link\", \"Export JSON\". Keep the menu keyboard friendly. Liam Chen: Implementation note: ensure copy shortcut doesn't conflict with global shortcuts. Maybe allow Enter or Space on pill to copy; also show a small check icon on success for 1.5s. Maya Patel: UX microcopy: For the menu item, prefer verbs: \"Open trace\", \"Copy ID\", \"Export trace (JSON)\". Keep labels concise. Rachel Ng: Also add tooltip for truncated IDs: \"Correlation ID: abc123def... — press Enter to copy\" and add role=\"tooltip\" with proper aria-describedby hookup. Maya Patel: Ok next steps — I'll update Figma with the pill + overflow pattern and contrast tweaks. @Rachel will draft the a11y copy + aria snippets. @Omar will prototype keyboard order and copy behavior. @Liam will review visual contrast and the success state animation. Omar Reyes: I'll try to prototype the tabindex behavior in the prototype build and post results. Liam Chen: Will check contrast tokens and propose updated styles. Rachel Ng: Drafting a11y doc now, will post in this thread when ready. Maya Patel: Thanks all :thumbsup: Will aim to push updated Figma file by EOD and link here.
